summary: Calls ValueGetter with the global dword_8B8F28, then, when the element count at this+0x120 is greater than 0, iterates the secondary element array at this+0x124 (36-byte stride). Each element is dereferenced twice (element + 8, then + 4) to reach an object whose flags word at +156 (0x9C) is read; when bit 2 (0x2) is set, bit 1 (0x1) is ORed into the same word. Returns the element count as the function result.

For each element, dereference element + 8 then + 4 to reach the target object, and test bit 2 (0x2) in the flags word at +0x9C; the flag write happens only when that bit is set
When bit 0x2 was set, OR bit 1 (0x1) into the same flags word at v5 + 0x9C
